svg.title: calc.js — one expression from text to number
svg.desc: A tokenizer cuts "2*(3+4)" into tokens, toRpn reorders them with an operator stack, and evaluate runs them on a value stack to print 14. A second trace shows "2$" rejected with a SyntaxError.
svg.text: calc.js — one expression from text to number
Static walkthrough of calc.js using the input from calc.test.js. Not a recording.

g.text: 1/20 the expression enters tokenize() as one string
2/20 digit runs become num tokens, + - * / ( ) become op tokens
3/20 toRpn() walks tokens[] one at a time
4/20 a num goes straight to out[]
5/20 * finds ops[] empty and waits there
8/20 + is pushed: ( on top has no precedence, so nothing pops
10/20 ) pops + back out and drops the ( fence
12/20 input is done, so ops[] drains: *
13/20 out[] now holds 2 3 4 + * in postfix order
14/20 evaluate() reads out[] left to right
15/20 each num is pushed onto stack[]
19/20 reject · "2$": 2 is cut, then $ matches no branch
20/20 reject · SyntaxError "unexpected '$' at 1" is printed and the process exits 1
